definitions.explanation: To publish content on social media, video platforms, blogs, or other online services. The dominant modern usage.

definitions.gloss: to submit; to contribute (to a publication)
definitions.explanation: To send a manuscript, letter, or article to a newspaper, magazine, or journal for possible publication. The original meaning.

notes: The noun ⟦{投稿|とうこう}→投稿：04733_toukou⟧ is also very common on its own, meaning a 'post' or 'submission.' In modern Japanese, sense 1 (online posting) has become the primary usage. Common collocations: {投稿|とうこう}する (to post), ⟦{投稿|とうこう}→投稿：04733_toukou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{削除|さくじょ}→削除：04171_sakujo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (delete a post), ⟦{投稿者|とうこうしゃ}→投稿者：23839_toukousha⟧ (poster/contributor), {投稿日|とうこうび} (post date). Related term: ⟦{投稿|とうこう}{欄|らん}→投稿欄：25569_toukouran⟧ (letters/submissions section in a newspaper).
